subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what fields, redaction, account scope, and authorization semantics should it expose?
rationale: The issue is not a narrow missing command: it combines sensitive sender identifiers, authorization state, configured and pairing-store allowlists, group policy, and activity metadata, so code can implement it safely only after maintainers choose the product/security contract.

options.title: Define scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a canonical account-scoped CLI inventory that merges approved pairing entries, configured allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and authorization rules.

options.title: Narrow to pairing management first
options.body: Use #56621 to add approved-pairing list/revoke commands and defer group policy, directory labels, and last-active to a later design.

options.title: Defer to admin UI design
options.body: Keep the CLI surface minimal and handle contact permissions through a broader admin UI or permission-management project.

recommendation.title: Define scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a canonical account-scoped CLI inventory that merges approved pairing entries, configured allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and authorization rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent adjacent work spans pairing-store helpers, allowlist command helpers, and channel status formatting, making them the best routing owner among the observed history signals.
